entries.rationale: The Carretera a El Salvador corridor (Santa Catarina Pinula 1108695621, Fraijanes 421185999) functions as part of Guatemala City, and the municipality of Guatemala (421191461) is named bare 'Guatemala', which reads as a country-level label. Coarse cells keep their original owner so remote fallback points stay country-ish. Mixco and Villa Nueva intentionally keep their own names. Note on 421191461: in the current world build it owns no cells at precision 5, because Guatemala City's locality polygon already covers its municipal territory, so absorbing it is a no-op today; it stays in the list as future-proofing for builds where the municipality does win cells.
